#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

long long modInv(long long a) {
    long long g = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
    for (long long r = a; r != 0; ) {
        long long q = g / r;
        g %= r;
        long long t = g;
        g = r;
        r = t;
        x -= q * y;
        t = x;
        x = y;
        y = t;
    }
    x %= MOD;
    if (x < 0) x += MOD;
    return x;
}

long long add(long long a, long long b) {
    long long v = a + b;
    return v < MOD ? v : v - MOD;
}

long long smallInv(int x, const vector<long long>& fact, const vector<long long>& invFact) {
    return invFact[x] * fact[x - 1] % MOD;
}

int main() {
    long long n_ll, m_ll;
    cin >> n_ll >> m_ll;
    int n = (int)n_ll;
    int m = (int)m_ll;

    int max = n + m;
    vector<long long> fact(max + 1);
    vector<long long> invFact(max + 1);

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= max; i++) {
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    }

    invFact[max] = modInv(fact[max]);
    for (int i = max; i >= 1; i--) {
        invFact[i - 1] = invFact[i] * i % MOD;
    }

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = p * (n - i) % MOD * smallInv(n + m - i, fact, invFact) % MOD;
        phaseSize = add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long sign = ((k + 1) & 1) == 0 ? 1 : MOD - 1;
        long long numPhases = (m + k) % MOD * smallInv(k, fact, invFact) % MOD;
        long long ncr = fact[n] * invFact[k] % MOD * invFact[n - k] % MOD;
        long long term = sign * ncr % MOD * numPhases % MOD * phaseSize % MOD;
        answer = add(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
